lines.say: If your interview is tomorrow, this fixes your opening answer.
lines.show: Interview tomorrow? Fix your first 45 seconds.

lines.say: Ask it plainly? AI says hardworking, passionate, team player.
lines.show: Plain ask: hardworking, passionate, team player.

lines.say: AI is a tailor. No measurements? You get a loose shirt.
lines.show: AI is a tailor. No measurements, free size.

lines.say: Give it measurements: your role, your goal, the format.
lines.show: Give it measurements: role, goal, format.

lines.say: Then three true facts. Example: billing, Tally, many vendors.
lines.show: Then 3 true facts. Example: billing, Tally, 40 vendors.

lines.say: Now your whole opening answer sounds like you.
lines.show: Now: 45 seconds that sound like you.

lines.say: The catch: true facts only, no made-up experience. Say it out loud first.
lines.show: The catch: true facts only. Practise aloud.

lines.say: Send this to the friend whose interview is on Monday. Comment INTRO.
